frame_row: Document-grounded proposed cluster; no RTL hierarchy or protocol compliance is asserted.

label: Coherent fabric
(home + routing)
blocks.function: Proposed local ownership and request-routing subsystem. It resolves cache probes, serializes conflicting lines and routes non-cacheable accesses to the peripheral fabric. Not expanded.

label: Coherent memory
(L2 + ACE proxy)
blocks.function: Proposed memory subsystem combining optional shared L2 and external coherent proxy. It handles system-facing requests and returns snoop results from local ownership tracking. External full-coherent support remains integration work. Not expanded.

label: Peripheral fabric
(AXI4 MMIO router)
blocks.function: Proposed non-cacheable peripheral routing and response-ordering subsystem. It isolates MMIO from allocating cache paths and handles decode errors. Not expanded.

label: Debug subsystem
(DTM + DM + SBA)
blocks.function: Proposed multi-hart debug subsystem with transport, run control and coherent normal-memory system-bus access. Native feature compatibility must be confirmed. Not expanded.

label: Performance monitor
(counters + snapshot)
blocks.function: Proposed per-hart and shared performance accumulators, latency tracking and snapshot engine. Passive observation must not backpressure execution. Not expanded.

label: Cluster management
(APB + power + wake)
blocks.function: Proposed management register bank and coordinated boot, quiesce, reset and wake controller. Cross-domain operations use acknowledged commands. Not expanded.

label: Flight recorder
(trigger + event RAM)
blocks.function: Proposed bounded timestamped event recorder with pre/post-trigger capture and observable loss handling. Not a standard instruction-trace encoder. Not expanded.

label: CPU tile bank
(2 or 4 core + L1)
blocks.row_name: CPU tile bank: hart 0/1; hart 2/3 only for N=4
blocks.function: Architectural array of two or four identical CPU tiles, each with its own core and private L1 instruction/data caches. Hart 0 and 1 are always present; hart 2 and 3 exist only in the four-core build. Replicated interfaces are indexed per tile, not a single physical shared bus. Not expanded at level 1.

interfaces.name: Coherent memory service
interfaces.signals: Fabric -> memory: normal-memory request; memory -> fabric: request completion/read data/error. External-initiated local snoop work is separately represented by LPROB.

interfaces.name: Uncached peripheral requests
interfaces.signals: Fabric -> router: uncached address/control and write payload; router -> fabric: read payload, completion and errors.

interfaces.name: Coherent debug memory access
interfaces.signals: Debug -> fabric: cacheless coherent memory requests; fabric -> debug: completion/read data/error. Not a raw DRAM bypass.

interfaces.name: Fabric event observation
interfaces.signals: Fabric -> PMU: ownership, probe, queue and atomic events; names and widths TBD.

interfaces.name: Memory event observation
interfaces.signals: Memory -> PMU: shared-cache and external request/response events; names and widths TBD.

interfaces.name: MMIO event observation
interfaces.signals: Router -> PMU: MMIO handshakes, errors, backpressure and pending-request observations.

interfaces.name: Recorder trigger and event feed
interfaces.signals: PMU -> recorder: selected timestamped records and trigger requests. Recorder full drops records and reports loss; no execution backpressure.

interfaces.name: PMU configuration and readback
interfaces.signals: Management -> PMU: selectors, masks and snapshot commands; PMU -> management: snapshot/status/acknowledgments.

interfaces.name: Recorder configuration and readback
interfaces.signals: Management -> recorder: trigger and read commands; recorder -> management: records, status and loss counters.

interfaces.name: Debug policy and wake coordination
interfaces.signals: Management -> debug: policy and coordinated wake/configuration; debug -> management: availability/status and wake requirements.

interfaces.name: Fabric management
interfaces.signals: Management -> fabric: supported quiesce/route-policy commit; fabric -> management: command and drained-state acknowledgments.

interfaces.name: Proposed ACE request service
interfaces.signals: Outward: normal/coherent memory requests and write payload; inward: read/write completion. Full protocol channel fields and widths not finalized.

interfaces.name: Proposed ACE snoop service
interfaces.signals: Inward: snoop requests; outward: snoop responses/data with required protocol acknowledgment behavior. Not RTL-proven ACE compliance.

interfaces.name: Proposed AXI4 peripheral interface
interfaces.signals: Outward: AW/W/AR request channels; inward: B/R response channels; VALID/READY both directions. Actual RTL port names and widths TBD.

interfaces.name: Proposed APB4 management interface
interfaces.signals: Inward: PSEL, PENABLE, PADDR[15:0], PWRITE, PWDATA[31:0], PSTRB[3:0], PPROT[2:0]; outward: PRDATA[31:0], PREADY, PSLVERR. Proposed boundary fields, not RTL names.

interfaces.name: Proposed JTAG TCK pin
interfaces.signals: TCK: single dedicated JTAG pad line; proposed semantics, implementation not selected.

interfaces.name: Proposed JTAG TMS pin
interfaces.signals: TMS: single dedicated JTAG pad line; proposed semantics, implementation not selected.

interfaces.name: Proposed JTAG TDI pin
interfaces.signals: TDI: single dedicated JTAG pad line; proposed semantics, implementation not selected.

interfaces.name: Proposed JTAG TDO pin
interfaces.signals: TDO: single dedicated JTAG pad line; proposed semantics, implementation not selected.

interfaces.name: Per-hart platform interrupts
interfaces.signals: Per-hart timer, inter-processor and platform interrupt inputs; proposed routing directly into tile bank. Exact vector width and core interrupt interface TBD.

interfaces.name: Cluster event interrupts
interfaces.signals: Cluster PMU, recorder and fault interrupt status, proposed level semantics from architecture section 6; exact pins TBD.

interfaces.name: Cluster domain integration
interfaces.signals: Cluster clock, management clock, reset and wake infrastructure; logical domain boundary only. Internal clock-tree wiring is not defined by the source architecture.

interfaces.name: Local snoop service
interfaces.signals: Memory proxy -> fabric: external probe work; fabric -> memory proxy: aggregated snoop response and dirty data. Exact RTL names, widths and timing TBD.

interfaces.name: Replicated tile transactions
interfaces.signals: For each present hart independently: tile-to-fabric memory requests and fabric-to-tile completion/read data. Address/attributes choose coherent normal memory or uncached MMIO. Separate per-tile interfaces; not one shared physical link.

interfaces.name: Replicated tile event observation
interfaces.signals: Per-tile retirement multiplicity, pipeline/cache/TLB event observations to PMU; source/hart association retained. Exact names, widths and timing TBD.

interfaces.name: Replicated native hart debug
interfaces.signals: Debug-to-hart supported halt/resume/step transactions; per-hart state/completion returned. Not a claim of native halt-group support.

interfaces.name: Replicated tile management
interfaces.signals: Management-to-tile boot/quiesce/wake/reset requests with per-hart acknowledgment and actual state returned. Exact native interfaces TBD.

legend_note: DOCUMENT PROPOSAL. CPU bank = 2/4 separate tiles; each has private core + L1I/L1D. Dashed outlines = proposed, not RTL-proven. TILE, TEVT, HDBG, TCTL are replicated per-hart interfaces. Arrow = initiator; response signals are included.
